versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update: Airtable CLI v2 brings expanded features and improved automation support.

- Full Airtable API coverage with enhanced commands.
- Added pagination support and robust rate-limit awareness.
- Introduced CSV import/export and field filtering capabilities.
- New config file support (airtable_config.json) for easier setup.
- Command-line self-test and CI integration examples included.
- Replaced/updated documentation files and added new Python scripts.

Initial release of airtable-cli.

- Command-line tool to interact with Airtable: read, create, update, delete, and search records.
- Supports listing bases and tables.
- Enables batch record upsert and filtering records.
- Outputs JSON for easy integration with other tools.
- Handles Airtable API rate limits automatically.
